title: Checkout shows its total after the price lookup
summary: The checkout read the total before the async price lookup had answered, so a slow lookup left the page showing $NaN. The total now waits for the lookup, and a regression test covers the race.

changes.now: The total shows $42.50 once the lookup answers.
